title: Simplify shopkeeper login flow after admin approval

requirements.text: Modify the shopkeeper authentication flow to automatically enable shop functionality immediately after admin approval without requiring additional login steps or permission checks

quotes: Make it more easier to log in as shopkeeper it is to complex it is not responding to get in after getting permission from admin

acceptanceCriteria: When admin approves a shop registration, the shopkeeper can immediately access their dashboard without re-authenticating
Shopkeeper users see their shop status update in real-time or after a single page refresh
No additional permission prompts or loading states block shopkeeper access after approval
The shop dashboard page (ShopDashboardPage) detects approval status and displays shop management controls without requiring logout/login

requirements.text: Add automatic query invalidation and refetch when shop approval status changes so shopkeepers see updated permissions without manual refresh

quotes: it is not responding to get in after getting permission from admin

acceptanceCriteria: When an admin approves a shop, all active shopkeeper sessions automatically refetch user profile and shop data
Shopkeeper UI transitions from 'pending approval' to 'active shop' state without requiring page reload
React Query cache invalidation triggers when shop status changes from pending to approved

requirements.text: Remove any unnecessary authentication barriers or complex permission checks that prevent shopkeepers from accessing their dashboard after initial Internet Identity login and admin approval

quotes: Make it more easier to log in as shopkeeper it is to complex

acceptanceCriteria: Shopkeeper role users only need to authenticate once with Internet Identity
After shop approval, no additional login prompts or permission gates block access to inventory, orders, or ledger pages
The RoleGuard component correctly identifies approved shopkeepers and grants immediate access to shopkeeper routes

constraints: Do not modify the Internet Identity authentication mechanism
Preserve the admin approval workflow for shop registrations
Maintain the existing role-based access control structure (customer/shopkeeper/admin)
Keep the single-actor Motoko backend architecture
nonGoals: Removing the admin approval requirement for new shops
Changing the Internet Identity login flow
Modifying the customer or admin login experiences
